* Implements the subset of the JDK Signature interface needed for
 * signature verification using OpenSSL.
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

variables.name: key
variables.comment: * The current OpenSSL key we're operating on.

variables.name: engineType
variables.comment: * Holds the type of the Java algorithm.

variables.name: singleByte
variables.comment: * Holds a dummy buffer for writing single bytes to the digest.

variables.name: signing
variables.comment: * True when engine is initialized to signing.

variables.comment: * Public key algorithm context (reference to {@code EVP_PKEY_CTX}).
